From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Karthik / Aditya — see guidance and suggested language below. I kept this intentionally practical for procurement / broker handoff.

1) Coverage minimums (recommend we confirm these in the order form):
- Commercial General Liability (including products/completed ops): $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
- Professional Liability / Errors & Omissions: $2,000,000 per claim / $2,000,000 aggregate (claims-made accepted)
- Cyber/Privacy Liability: $2,000,000 per incident (claims-made). If buyer requires occurrence-based cyber, we need to review with our carrier — expect longer lead time and cost impact.
- Umbrella: $5,000,000 (if buyer requires higher combined limits)

2) Additional Insured (CGL only):
- We will provide an Additional Insured endorsement for Commercial General Liability on a primary and non-contributory basis via ISO CG 20 10 (or equivalent) wording. If BrightBridge requests affiliates, they must provide a list of named entities to appear on the endorsement; we do not grant open-ended affiliate definitions.

Suggested endorsement text to provide to broker (sample):
"Brightwood Inference, its subsidiaries and affiliates as listed in Schedule A are included as Additional Insureds with respect to liability arising out of Redwood Inference's operations performed for BrightBridge Analytics. Coverage will be primary and non-contributory as to any other valid and collectible insurance available to the Additional Insureds."

(We will replace 'Brightwood Inference' with 'Redwood Inference' in the final doc — broker copy here.)

3) E&O / Cyber AI:
- We do not typically extend Additional Insured status for professional liability (E&O) or cyber policies. Alternative: offer a contractual hold-harmless for E&O/cyber and provide full limits evidence on the COI. If BrightBridge insists on AI for cyber, this will require carrier negotiation and likely a premium uplift.

4) Claims notice / contact:
- Acceptable notice recipients: buyer, buyer's broker, or buyer's counsel. Notice may be sent to claims@redwood.com and to our legal mailbox (legal@redwood.com) for awareness. For carrier routing we will coordinate internally; buyer's broker notice is acceptable as initial notice.

5) Retroactive date / claims-made:
- Claims-made policies are acceptable for E&O/cyber if a retroactive date on or prior to the order-form effective date is provided. If BrightBridge cannot obtain a retro date, we will accept on a case-by-case basis but may require extended reporting period (ERP) coverage or alternative mitigation.

6) COI/certificate holder language (on the COI):
- Certificate Holder: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Address: 200 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Additional Insured Endorsement: ISO CG 20 10 (or equivalent) — primary/non-contributory; named entities per Schedule A

Action items for Karthik:
- Share the attached COI_template.pdf and Clean_MSA_redline.pdf with BrightBridge and their broker. COI template contains the AI sample wording and the fields BrightBridge requested.
- Request the buyer's broker to confirm whether they can supply a retroactive date for cyber (if BrightBridge requires cyber AI, tell them that's likely a blocker).
- Ask BrightBridge to provide the exact affiliate list if they want affiliates named on the endorsement.

Attachments: COI_template.pdf, Clean_MSA_redline.pdf

If you want, I can produce final endorsement wording for signature once BrightBridge confirms affiliates and cyber position.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
